_comment: LCP gate is 3000ms (warn) in CI to account for Lighthouse's simulated 4x CPU throttle on mobile, which adds ~500ms of unavoidable simulated layout cost on a 1600+ element DOM. Real-world field LCP target stays at the Core Web Vitals 2500ms threshold; track that via PageSpeed Insights / CrUX, not this CI gate.
_comment_runs: numberOfRuns is 3 because single-run collection made this gate unreliable: three CI runs against identical site code returned performance scores of 0.55, 0.79 and 0.49, and total-blocking-time swung from under 300ms to 2677ms. A real regression would have been invisible inside that spread. Asserting against the median run makes the gate meaningful.
